gloss: out of range; out of service area; no signal

definitions.gloss: out of range; out of service area; no signal
definitions.explanation: Being outside the coverage area where a mobile phone can receive signal.

definitions.gloss: outside the sphere; out of scope
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, being outside a certain area or scope of concern.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{中|なか}で{圏外|けんがい}になった。
examples.english: I lost signal in the mountains.

examples.japanese: ここは{圏外|けんがい}だから{電話|でんわ}ができない。
examples.english: I can't make calls here because there's no signal.

examples.japanese: その{問題|もんだい}は{私|わたし}の{関心|かんしん}の{圏外|けんがい}だ。
examples.english: That issue is outside my sphere of concern.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{圏|けん} (sphere, area) + {外|がい} (outside)

PHONE DISPLAY:
When a phone has no signal, the screen typically shows 「{圏外|けんがい}」 where the signal bars would normally be.

RELATED:
・{圏内|けんない} - within range (antonym)
・{電波|でんぱ}が{届|とど}かない - signal doesn't reach
・アンテナが{立|た}たない - no bars (colloquial)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{圏外|けんがい}になる - to go out of range
・{圏外|けんがい}で〜できない - can't ~ because out of range
